correctness.rationale: All essential computations re-derived by hand and replayed exactly. Intersection law (*) follows from D^3=2, D^2.F1=-2, D^2.F2=-1, D.F1.F2=2 with F-pure terms zero; gives (-K)^3=14. S(F2)=(19/2+7/4)/14=45/56 and S(F1)=(19/4+7/8)/14=45/112 follow from BL Props 5.2/5.1 Zariski data (ample kinks 1-u and 1-2u match Mori dots; tau-endpoint volumes vanish: F1 vol at u=1 is 0, F2 vol at u=2 is 0). S(D)=(17/2)/14=17/28 follows from -K-uD=(1-u)D+F1+2F2 nef on [0,1] (dots 1+u on L_i, 2-2u on C; Mori cone <L1,L2,C> per BL Sec 3) with N=0, tau(D)=1 via simplicial Eff=<D,F1,F2> (Matsuki+erratum) and N1-basis determinant -4; volume 2t^3-12t^2+24t integrates to 17/2. D-flag with Z of type (1,0): P(u)|_D-vZ=(u-v+1,u+1), R^2=2(u-v+1)(u+1), inner integral (u+1)^3, outer 15/4, times 3/14 gives 45/56; identical second integral since N=0 and R.Z=u+1; delta_P>=min(28/17,56/45)=56/45. A=1 for smooth prime divisors D,F1,F2. Stdlib-only Fractions script replays every identity: VERIFY_OK, no floating point. Draft honestly separates proved (hand integration), computed evidence (script), reproductions (F2, D-flag labelled non-original), and conjecture (full K-stability). Boundary conditions and uniformity over special stratum checked: general-fibre divisors and Mori/Eff data are family-uniform; special-stratum issue concerns multiple-fibre singularities, not these thresholds.

originality.rationale: Nearest prior BL 2403.03700 v3 proves K-stability only under explicit (star) (A1 along C for multiple fibres), states authors expect all members K-stable but are 'unable to prove this at the moment'; Cor 1.2/1.3 are conditional. Exact-phrase arXiv search returns only 2403.03700 for this family. BL Sec 5 computes only S(F2)=45/56 (explicitly reduces to L=F2) and never computes S(F1) or S(D); Lemma 6.1 states P(u)=-K-uD,N=0 and flag integrals 45/56 but never computes S(D). Draft's S(F1)=45/112 and S(D)=17/28 are therefore absent from BL; text search for '45/112' returns no arXiv hit. Abban-Zhuang 2003.13788 is a general flag method with no stratum verdict; Liu 2204.06709 is family No.2.8 (rank-2 double cover); Fujita degree-28 is disjoint. Reproduced items (F2, D-flag) are explicitly labelled non-original, so no misattribution. The two new beta values are not mechanically contained in any prior verdict.

value.rationale: Headline (fallback-a partial theorem) is two rigorously established exact divisorial invariants of a natural pre-motivated object: S(F1)=45/112, beta=67/112 and S(D)=17/28, beta=11/28 for the Eff-generators of smooth rank-3 degree-14 Fano threefolds, valid uniformly over the BL-excluded special stratum, plus honest sharpness note isolating the missing non-A1 multiple-fibre W^{F2,C} term. Object (Mori-Mukai family + named divisors) and invariant (beta/S feeding K-moduli/KE program) were motivated before computation by the BL gap; values were unknown and not mechanically implied (BL deliberately skipped them); a future attacker of this or adjacent rank-3 families needs these precise beta positivities as lemmas narrowing the destabilizing cone. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: full volume-function logs, limits, and interpretation (divisorial positivity, delta>=56/45 on D) are given. Incomplete full K-verdict is described honestly and does not erase the independently retrievable lemma value per exact-invariant clause.
